recognize_zh: 室溫培養的菌落以乳酸酚棉藍（lactophenol cotton blue）染色，可見細長有隔的無色菌絲，以及一顆表面帶指狀突起的圓形大分生孢子（tuberculate macroconidium），這是莢膜組織胞漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）黴菌相的特徵。
features: Thin, hyaline, septate, branching hyphae forming a loose mycelial network
A single large spherical thick-walled macroconidium with regular knob-like (tuberculate) surface projections
Small smooth round microconidia along or near hyphae
Lactophenol cotton blue wet mount of room-temperature (mold phase) culture; no host cells present
describe_en: Lactophenol cotton blue preparation from a fungal culture incubated at room temperature shows thin, hyaline, septate branching hyphae. A large, round, thick-walled macroconidium bearing evenly spaced finger-like surface projections (tuberculate macroconidium) is present, together with scattered small smooth microconidia. This is the mould phase of a thermally dimorphic fungus; the findings are consistent with Histoplasma capsulatum, and confirmation by conversion to the yeast phase, DNA probe/PCR or antigen testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Sepedonium produces similar tuberculate macroconidia but is not thermally dimorphic, lacks microconidia and fails Histoplasma DNA probe/antigen confirmation.
Blastomyces mould shows only small oval 'lollipop' conidia on short conidiophores without large tuberculate macroconidia.
T. marneffei mould forms brush-like penicilli and a diffusible red pigment rather than tuberculate macroconidia.
